node.label: Reduced peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase activity
node.definition: Diminished enzyme activity of peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase, an enzyme that metabolizes glutaryl-CoA (a metabolite of L-lysine, L-hydroxy-lysine and L-tryptophan) by dehydrogenation to glutaconyl-CoA directly followed by decarboxylation of this to crotonyl-CoA.

evidence.snippet: Glutaricaciduria, type I: Reduced peroxisomal glutaryl-CoA oxidase activity (frequency 181/181) [PCS]
